label: Devin CLI
description: One conversation with Devin CLI, Cognition's coding agent: three conversations are three nodes. Wire `agent` and `stream` into an AskAgent and talk to it in a Loop; end the loop with a CloseBus on `stream`, which ends this node's part of the run. With no `computer`, Devin CLI runs on your machine (a local install only) from your own install of `devin`, working in `folder`. If `devin` is missing, weft installs it into a folder of its own, shared by the whole machine, before the node runs. With a `computer` wired, it is installed and run inside that computer, which a cloud install needs. Either way it logs in with the connection on `access`. It always runs on the connection's login, in a home of its own: on your machine's own login it would read your config and import your Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot, OpenCode and Zed settings. Your Devin organization's rules still apply in every permission setting. Its card shows what it is doing and a Start over button. What is exposed: the permission mode, the model and the models to switch to when a request is refused. Your program's tools reach Devin's model as `mcp__weft__<tool>`, and come back to your program under their plain names. Devin CLI cannot let a program's tool take one of its own tools' places, so a tool named like one of them (`read`, `edit`, `exec` and the rest of this node's list) is refused when the program is built.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: A Computer to run Devin CLI in. Left out, it runs on your machine, which only a local install has. Several agents may share one computer.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: A DevinCliAccess's `access`: a Devin API key. Required, because this agent never runs on a login already on your machine.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: The folder Devin CLI works in. On your machine it is required, and must exist. In a computer it is a path inside the computer, its home folder when left out.

inputs.name: program
inputs.label: Program
inputs.description: On your machine: the Devin CLI program to run, when it is not the `devin` on your PATH or the one weft installs (an install of your own, a version you keep for this). A path on your machine, so it cannot go with a `computer`.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.label: Permissions
inputs.description: What Devin CLI may do without asking. `ask`: every edit, command and fetch comes out of AskAgent as a question. `accept_edits`: edits in the folder go ahead, commands and fetches ask. `read_only`: it answers without changing code. `plan`: it only plans. `bypass`: nothing asks, nothing is refused; for a computer, which is the wall around it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A model name Devin knows, matched loosely as its `/model` does (`opus`, `swe-1-6-fast`, ...). Left out, Devin's default.

inputs.name: streamBy
inputs.label: Stream by
inputs.description: What goes out on `stream`: `message`, one event per whole message, tool use and result, so a run waiting on a long step sleeps; `token`, every piece of text as it is written too, which keeps the run awake while the agent writes.

inputs.name: refusalFallback
inputs.label: Fallback models
inputs.description: Models to switch to, in order, when the provider refuses a request under its usage policy.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The agent's handle: wire it into AskAgent's `agent`. Baked: made when the infra is started.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: Everything the agent does in this run, as AskAgent sends it. Wire it into every AskAgent of the loop, and into a CloseBus after the loop: the run's part of this node ends when it does.

then.message: DevinCli '{id}' runs on the machine weft runs on, which a cloud install does not have; wire a Computer into `computer`.
DevinCli '{id}' runs only on a connection's login: on your machine's own it would import your other agents' settings; give it a DevinCliAccess on `access`.
DevinCli '{id}' works on your machine, so it needs a `folder` to work in.
DevinCli '{id}' has a `permission` it does not know; pick one of ask, accept_edits, read_only, plan, bypass.
DevinCli '{id}' has a `streamBy` it does not know; pick message or token.
DevinCli '{id}' runs in a computer, where `program`, a path on your machine, means nothing; leave `program` out, the computer installs Devin CLI itself.
